name: AfroMedia Plc
source: Afromedia Plc audited financial statements for the period ended 31 December 2022 (NGX doclib filing, approved by the board 31 March 2023). Filing in NGN thousands; stored here in absolute NGN.
source_note: Naira thousands. Group column of the statement of cash flow printed in the audited FY2019 statements, carrying the Q1 2020 column (first quarter ended 31 December 2019) and the FY2019 audited comparative as filed. Operating plus investing plus financing reproduces the printed increase in cash and cash equivalents in both columns. Capital expenditure is the printed purchase of intangible assets; the group printed no other investing item.
note: FY2021 operating less investing plus financing equals the printed net movement exactly. FY2022 comes to 1,036 against the printed 1,037, the same one-unit rounding that runs through this filing, and the printed figure is stored. Capital expenditure is the filing line increase in property, plant and equipment, shown as a negative outflow. Free cash flow is operating plus capex.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding
